<thought>We need to identify the unknown organic sample by analyzing its spectral data. The tools that return data for the sample without requiring a SMILES input are: mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra (requires SMILES), carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra. The first step is to obtain the mass spectrum to determine the molecular weight and possible molecular formula. This will guide further analysis.</thought>
